utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, I think we're all here. Sven, can you hear us alright?

utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, I'm here. Sorry, the train had no signal for a bit, I just got back on.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: No worries. So, a few things today, nothing huge.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Is Camila on?

utterances.text: I'm here. Just muted.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Great. First, the Thursday release. Sana, where are we on that?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Build's green as of this morning. There's one flaky test on the settings screen, but it fails like one in ten runs.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Is that blocking?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: No, I mean, it's not the screen itself, it's the test. I'll look at it-

utterances.text: Is that the one that does the animation wait? Because I hit that same thing on the profile screen back in, what, September?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Probably. Probably the same helper.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yeah, someone hardcoded a timeout in there. Two seconds, I think. Which is fine on a laptop and terrible on the CI box.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, can you two sort that out offline?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Yep.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Good. Camila, the store listing screenshots, did those come back from design?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes, Anika sent them yesterday. Two of them still have the old logo.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Oh. That's not great.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I asked her to redo them. She said Monday.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Monday's fine, as long as it's before the submission.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It is. Submission's Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. So the other thing, and this one's got a clock on it, is the push thing. The contract with the provider runs out at the end of the month.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Right. I looked at the renewal paperwork on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: And remind me, it's a year or month to month?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: They offered both. Month to month is more per month.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Mm. How much more?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Over a thousand. I'd have to look.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Is this the one Sanne from procurement keeps emailing about?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I think so, yes. She wanted an answer by the fifteenth.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: She's very persistent. She emailed me too, and I'm not even on the contract.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: She emailed everybody.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. So, Pavel, where's your head on it?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Just renew it. A year, nine hundred a month, done.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Say more, though, so everyone's got it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It already does the segmentation for us, all the audience groups marketing set up. That's four point two million pushes a month right now.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: And nobody on this team touches it. No upkeep. If we rebuilt it ourselves it's two engineers for six weeks, easily.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Six weeks is generous, I'd say, because the retry logic alone-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fine, so more.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Yeah, so more, I'd say.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Right. So nobody's super excited about building it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'm not, no. Although, I mean, there's an argument that-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: We looked at this last spring, didn't we?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: We looked at something. I don't remember it going far.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: It didn't. It was a spike, I think.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Can I ask what the number is per push?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Per push it's tiny. Fractions of a cent, basically.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. I just wanted to know if it was going to jump around.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Flat fee. It doesn't move with volume until we go way past where we are.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Anyone have a reason not to do it?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Uh, honestly, no. The only thing I'd say is the annual part, if we change our minds mid-year are we stuck?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Yes. That's the trade.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right, right. I figured.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: It's what you get for the lower rate.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And the finance side, does Davor have to sign?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: He does. Anything over ten thousand a year goes through him.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: That's, what, ten eight?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Ten point eight, yes. So yes.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay, so that goes to him.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, so we're renewing the push provider for the year at nine hundred a month.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I'll send Sanne the yes today.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Thanks. And copy me so I can forward to Davor.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Can I ask something totally different?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Go for it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: The team offsite, is that still in January? Because I need to book a flight if it's in Berlin.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I thought we said Berlin. Camila, didn't you check venues?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I got two quotes. One is a hotel conference room, the other is a co-working space.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Which was cheaper?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The co-working one. Quite a bit.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Can you send me both?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes. Today.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Is the date set though? Because last I heard it was the twentieth or the twenty-seventh.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Twentieth, I think. I'll confirm.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I have a thing on the twenty-seventh anyway, so that's good.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Okay, I'll hold off booking until you confirm.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Yeah, hold off, please.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Anything else? I have a call at the top of the hour.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: A couple minutes. Sana, how's Tadeusz's onboarding going?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Fine. He's got the repo running locally, and he fixed a typo in the readme, so, you know, he's contributing.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Ha. Good. Is he paired with anyone?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: With me, mostly. Sven's going to take him for the networking layer next week.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right, the networking layer. That's a lot to dump on someone in week two.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: He's sharp, he'll be fine.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I just remember my second week, I got handed the auth code and I didn't sleep.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Let's be gentle then.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'll be gentle. I'll start with the easy bits.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Thandi was asking if he'd be on call by December.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'd say no. January at the earliest.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, I'll tell her January.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Is he going to the offsite?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I'd think so, yes. It's a good way to meet people.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. I'll add him to the headcount for the venue.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Thanks, Camila. Anything else from anyone?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Nope.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Not from me.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I'm good.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Nothing here.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Great. Thanks, everyone. Pavel, go take your call.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Thanks. Bye.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, can everyone hear me? Sven, you were frozen a second ago.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'm here, I'm here. Sorry, I was fighting with the headphones.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Morning.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Morning. So, before the release stuff, I got an email last night and I'm still, uh, chewing on it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: From who?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: The push provider. Hang on, let me find the-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Is this about the renewal? Because Pavel already sent the-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I sent the yes. Last Sunday. Monday. Whatever, it went.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Right, it did. This is after that. They're switching everybody over to pay-per-use from next month, and I put our volume into their little calculator and it says something like twenty-seven hundred a month.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Twenty-seven hundred.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Yeah. So, three times what we thought we were paying. Give or take.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: But we signed a year at nine hundred. That was the whole-

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: That's what I thought too, but the email says the new schedule applies to everyone, and I haven't read the fine print properly yet.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Did you read any of it?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: The first page. Then Davor pinged me about something else.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Davor always pings at the worst moment. Last week he got me while I was in the middle of, actually, no, it was a Tuesday, I was on the train again-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sven.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Sorry. Go on.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: So the point is, nine hundred isn't what we're looking at anymore. We settled on the yearly thing on one set of numbers, and the numbers just moved.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Yeah, that's- yeah.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: So I want to take the whole push question back off the shelf before anything else goes out to them. Everyone okay with that?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Fine by me.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Sure. I did sort of wonder about the volume thing last week, when Camila asked about it-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I only asked if it would jump around.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right, and he said flat. Which was true then.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It was true then.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Nobody's blaming anybody. It's just an email.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: What's the other option, though? Building it ourselves? Because we said six weeks and that was-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Six weeks, two people. That was my number.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And I said more.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: You did say more.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I still think more. The retry stuff, the-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Can I say something about that?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Please, Camila.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Um. So the thing I keep coming back to is the audience groups. The ones marketing set up. Those aren't really living in the provider. The segments get worked out in our own user service, and the provider just gets handed a list and sends to it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Wait, really? I thought they built them in the dashboard.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Marketing looks at them there. But the data's ours. So we wouldn't redo that part at all, only the sending. I'd guess four weeks, two engineers, and then running it is maybe two-fifty a month plus a day a week of somebody looking after it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Huh. I didn't know that.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: A day a week of who?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Whoever's on it. I haven't thought about who.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It'd be me, let's be honest. It always ends up being me.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: It would not always be you.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Last spring-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: That was one time.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, okay. Camila, so against twenty-seven hundred, what does that look like?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: We'd save two thousand something a month once it's live. The build has to pay itself back first, so, about five months before it's even.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Five months. Not bad.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Roughly. I did it on the back of a notebook, don't hold me to it.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: What about the platforms' own services, though? Aren't there tokens or limits or-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Tokens we already store. The app registers them.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Oh. Yeah, okay, right.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: So what's the catch.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The upkeep, mostly. And it's four weeks those two aren't doing the other thing.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Which other thing?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: The checkout rework.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Right. That one slips a bit, I'd think.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: A bit as in two weeks, or a bit as in-

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I'd say about the four. I'll talk to Thandi.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: She'll want a date.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: She'll get a date.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Does the contract let us out of anything, now that their pricing changed?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: That's what I want to find out. I'll ask Sanne to send over the actual terms.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sanne's going to be thrilled.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: She emails us enough.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: She emailed me again this morning. About a laptop.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: A laptop?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: My old one. I'm supposed to return it. It's, uh, in a bag somewhere.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, so, on the push piece. I've heard enough. We're building our own sending service. Camila, can you sketch the plan with Pavel this week?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. Yes. I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Wednesday work?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Wednesday's good.

utterances.text: Want me to loop Sana in?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Please. I've got opinions on the retry thing.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: We know.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Release is still Thursday, right?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I think so. Anything blocking?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: The flaky settings test is fixed. Sven, it was the timeout.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Two seconds. I told you.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: You did tell you- me. You did tell me.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Hardcoded. In a helper. Somebody should be shamed.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Somebody was you.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It was before I was here. Possibly.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Offsite, quickly. Camila, did the quotes come through?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I sent both Friday. The co-working one's a lot cheaper.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I saw. I'll confirm the date this week. Sven, hold off on flights.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Holding.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Anything else?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: No. I've got a call.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Go. Thanks everyone.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, I think that's everyone. Sven, you're on mute, I can see your mouth moving.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Sorry, sorry. Hi. I was saying good morning to nobody.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Good morning to nobody, then. So, uh, where did the thing from Wednesday land? Pavel, Camila, you two sat down on it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: We did. Two hours. It's a doc now, sort of.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's more of a skeleton. I haven't put the, um, the sequence diagram in yet.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: That's fine. Just walk me through the shape of it.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: So there's a queue in front. The user service drops a message on it when marketing fires a campaign, and a worker picks up batches and sends them out to the platforms.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: One worker type for each platform. Not one big thing.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Why two? Is it- I mean, the retry stuff is the same either way-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The payloads are different. Different limits, different error codes.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Right, but the backoff could live in one place and-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's what I wrote down, actually. Shared retry, separate adapters.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Oh. Okay. Good.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: And that's, what, the four weeks we talked about?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's still about four. Maybe a bit more because of the error handling. I'd say four to five now.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Not wildly different.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Not wildly. I wouldn't promise a date to Thandi yet though.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: She keeps asking. I told her end of the year, loosely.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Loosely is right.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Can I ask about the, um, the tokens thing? Because I was reading something about how the tokens go stale when people uninstall, and then you get these errors back from the platform-

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: The invalid token ones. Yes. We'd have to clean those out as the responses come back.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right, because otherwise you keep sending into the void. I had a friend at another company, they sent to forty percent dead tokens for a year and nobody noticed until the bill-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: We don't have a bill per push.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: No, no, I know, this was a different setup. It was more the principle.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: So that's a cleanup job. Is that in the skeleton?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It's a line item. I haven't sized it.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Mm. Okay. Put a rough number next to it when you can.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I will.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Can I flag something? The provider's dashboard shows delivery receipts. Open rates too, I think. Do we get those?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The platforms give back a delivery status. Opens, we'd have to log from the app side.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Does the app already do that?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Some of it. Not all of it. I'd have to look.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Because marketing leans on those numbers, is all I'm saying.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Sunita mentioned it last week, actually. She was asking whether the reports would look the same.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: They won't look the same.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Right, but, like, close?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Close is a stretch. I'll talk to her.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Is that the same Sunita who does the, uh, the campaign calendar? Because she once sent me a calendar with every Friday highlighted in green and I never found out why.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Why do you remember that?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: It was very green.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Let's park that. Release. Where are we? Sana?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Thursday's build is cut. QA has it. They found one thing on the older Android phones, the keyboard covers the login button.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Is that new?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: No, it's been there. We just never tested the small screen with the long email layout.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Is it a fix or a known issue?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: I'd rather fix it. Maybe an hour.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Then fix it, as long as it doesn't move the date.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: It won't.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Who's on QA this week?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Tadeusz is sitting in with them, actually. He wanted to see the test devices.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Oh, nice. How's he doing?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Good. He asked a lot of questions about the notification screens, funnily.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: What kind?

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Like, where do the permission prompts get triggered. Nothing deep.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: That's actually relevant. If we change how it's sent, the opt-in path doesn't change, right?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Shouldn't. The app registers the token the same way.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Okay. I'll write that down so it doesn't get lost.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Good. Now, the offsite. I confirmed the date, it's the twentieth.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: The twentieth of January. Berlin.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Yes. So you can book now.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Great. Finally. I was going to look at flights last night and I got sidetracked, because I found this old route map and it turns out the train I take actually goes through, uh, I think it's Leipzig, and it's, well, the whole line was rebuilt in the nineties-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sven.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Right, yes. Flights. I'll book today.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Camila, the co-working space, did they confirm?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They said they'd hold the room until the end of the month. I need to send them a deposit.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: How much?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Something like a quarter of the total. I'll check the email.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Send me the number and I'll run it past Davor.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: And food. Do we need to think about food?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: They have a kitchen. We could order in. I haven't asked yet.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Fine. It can wait.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Can we go back to the push thing for a second?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: The provider. When does the plan with them actually end? Because Sanne's last email said the new pricing starts in December and I keep reading it differently.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I had the same problem. I think the pricing changes the first, but the contract itself, I don't know.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: So the overlap is the question.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Yes. Sanne said she'd send the actual terms. I haven't seen them.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Did you chase?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I sent a short note on Friday.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: She's usually quick.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Not on Fridays, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: She sent me the laptop thing on a Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Different department.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: Is it? I thought it was all one team.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Whatever the terms say, we still have to build the thing. So, what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Honestly, someone to say who looks after it once it's running. I keep leaving it blank in the doc.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Hm. I'd rather not answer that today. Can it stay blank a bit?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: It can. It just looks odd.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: I know. I'll come back to it.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I mean, if it's helpful, I'm not saying it'd be me-

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: It would be you.

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: I'm saying I'm not volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Noted.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: I need a staging setup for the queue. Who do I ask?

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Ask Anika's team? No, wait, that's design. Is it the platform people?

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Thandi's group, I think.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Then ask Thandi, she'll know who.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Okay. I'll message her after this.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: And a test device account for each platform, so we're not sending to real people.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Yes. That's on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Is it? I didn't see it.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: It's in my head. I'll put it on the list.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Okay. Good.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: I can add it. It's easy to add.

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay. Any other thing on this?

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Only that I'd like a second pair of eyes on the numbers before it goes further. The cost side especially.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Pavel, could you-

utterances.speaker: Pavel
utterances.text: Sure. Send it over when you're ready.

utterances.speaker: Camila
utterances.text: Thanks. Probably Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Great. I have to jump to another call. Anything else, quickly?

utterances.speaker: Sven
utterances.text: No, I'm good. Booking flights.

utterances.speaker: Sana
utterances.text: Nope.

utterances.speaker: Lena
utterances.text: Okay, thanks, everyone.
